_doc: Print-quality monitor (lib/printer_ops/quality.py): what was CALIBRATED beyond the generic QualityConfig defaults, per printer model. A model matches when its name, lowercased and stripped to letters and digits, ends with the key (Snapmaker U1 -> ...u1). Same keys as `<printer>.watch.quality`; the printer's own watch.quality wins. See docs/research/print-quality-monitor.md.
